summary: Iteration 16 - All 3 Features Tested and Working: (1) Marketing Pipeline month/year grouping with collapsible sections, (2) Revenue Recognition changed to cash basis (partial/paid only), (3) Expense category printing description updated to 'Training Materials Printing'

features_tested: Marketing Pipeline Lead grouping by month/year within each stage column
Month group collapsible toggle - click to expand/collapse
Current month (March 2026) expanded by default, older months (February 2026) collapsed
Each month group shows month label and lead count badge
Lead cards show all details (company, contact, value, date, source, quotation) within month groups
Pipeline and List view toggle still works
Revenue recognition - P&L only counts invoices with status 'partial' or 'paid' (not 'issued')
Session completion status NOT required for revenue recognition (cash basis)
Expense category 'printing' description is 'Training Materials Printing' (not '1% of invoice')
